Record of how the old repositories were converted. The conversion tables name old values, such as black, that were never palette entries.
Records the brief's own values for the Pequod crew, the starting point of the correction search. They come from the brief, not from a token file, and no output uses them.
A changelog records the old value and the new one. The old value no longer traces to a token by design.
